prompts.name: 01-drowned-archipelago
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D planet concept portrait for Void Drift, one of five exploratory renditions. Reference images: image 1 Earth study globe is the globe composition, soft lighting and surface rendering reference; image 2 Cradle game screenshot is only a material/readability reference (never reproduce UI); image 3 Mercury surface atlas is the subdued mineral texture reference. Create ONE original fictional spherical planet in space, centered whole circular globe, occupying 82% of a square canvas, equal margins, solid near-black navy background. Match the references' restrained painted astronomical game art: broad coherent terrain masses, convincing fine mineral surface texture subordinate to large shapes, softly shaded volume, light from upper left, gentle shadow toward lower right with terrain still visible. 2D raster illustration, polished but not cinematic CGI, no chunky low-poly facets, no cartoon outlines, no oversaturated fantasy colours. This world has an atmosphere conceptually but its atmosphere will be added later: show ONLY the unobscured planetary surface, NO clouds, NO atmospheric haze, NO luminous rim or halo. Water or ice must read distinctly from rock. No stars, sun, moons, spacecraft, rings, floating objects, labels, text, borders, UI, watermarks. Do not copy Earth's continents. Subject: A drowned archipelago world: deep muted slate-blue ocean covers 75% of the visible face; scattered broad weathered pale limestone islands and one fragmented olive-grey continent, beautifully readable shallow turquoise coastal shelves, small chalk-white polar ice. Science-fiction idea: three enormous ancient flooded circular basins partly interrupted by islands, subtle geological-scale suggestion of a lost engineered landscape. Keep circular structures sparse and integrated into the geography.
